title: Facebook Marketplace Automation Bot Update v1.0.1
description:
• 🪟 Standalone Portable Executable: Single .exe runs on any Windows 10/11 64-bit PC without Python.
• 🛡️ Local Persistent Storage: User accounts, cookies, and profiles permanently stored in %APPDATA%\FBMAutoBot.
• ⚡ Direct GitHub version.json Auto-Updater: Live streaming download with real-time MBs, speed tracking, and screen lock.
• 🌐 Anti-Detect Native Chrome Engine: Zero CDP flags for customer Messenger replies with 0% 180-day ban risk.
• 👥 Multi-Account Isolated Sessions: Independent SQLite cookie database and browser contexts.
